note: Sewer sounds for the hatch and the drain. All Freesound files are the public HQ preview MP3s (128 kbps), not the original WAV/FLAC (originals need a login). Every licence was read on the sound's own page (licence link http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Durations measured with ffprobe on the downloaded files. Judgements are from page title/description/tags plus a rough loudness, band-energy and envelope check, not listening. Dropped: 'Manhole Blows / Metallic Boom' (bevibeldesign 366093) is labelled CC0 but is built partly from Robinhood76 70799, which is CC BY-NC 4.0.

files.title: Manhole Cover Moving
files.author: WolfpackBrickfilms
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: A real manhole cover being moved (tags: manhole, metal, concrete, grinding, grating): broadband metal-on-concrete scrape, strongest around 1.5 s then fading. The exact subject, but quiet (mean -38.5 dB) and with little low end, so it needs gain; no creak/groan.

files.title: gate big rusty metal door garage open heavy creak rattle.flac
files.author: kyles
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: Big rusty metal garage door/gate swung open: one loud heavy creak with rattle, swelling to a peak at about 2 s and dying by 3.5 s. Best rusty creak/groan; it is a door, not a lid, so no ground scrape.

files.title: creaky_door_lound grind then squeak and grind at the end
files.author: theXRschool.com
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: Slow grind, a squeak, then a grind again; the uploader says it could be a heavy door or a coffin lid. Even level for about 3.5 s, mid-range; reads as a heavy lid dragged open. Material (metal or wood) not stated.

files.title: door metal big heavy close kinda slam thud echo offmic.wav
files.author: kyles
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: A big heavy metal door closed hard: one low, weighty slam-thud with a room echo, decaying over about 1 s. Low-heavy (most energy below 250 Hz). Best heavy single hit; more thud than ring.

files.title: Metal Door Slam_SoundSmith.wav
files.author: Lunardrive
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: A metal industrial door slammed shut, no effects added (per the page): one short, dry, low slam. Clean single hit; short tail, so it may want reverb for a tunnel.

files.title: Hard steel chain plate drop
files.author: ani_music
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: A steel chain/plate dropped, with reverb; the uploader says it 'almost sounds like a manhole cover'. One bright metallic clang with a reverberant tail. Thin in the lows (energy mostly above 2 kHz), so less weighty than the two above, and slightly over 3 s.

files.title: StormSewer.aiff
files.author: klangfabrik
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: Civic storm sewer recorded from the manhole: steady rushing water in a narrow concrete chamber with tight, comb-filtered reverb. Level flat within about 2 dB for the whole 91 s, no swells in the low band (no sign of traffic). Best flowing bed; continuous flow rather than separate drips.

files.title: lapping water in a sewer.wav
files.author: ProdMultimediasHQI
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: Slight water lapping in a sewer 'giving lots of echos' (page). Bright and watery, almost nothing below 250 Hz, steady level with small lapping movements; no low-band swells suggesting traffic. Gentler and more echoing than the storm sewer.

files.title: Underground Ambiance.wav
files.author: William020304
files.licence: Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0), per page licence link
files.sounds_like: An underground room/tunnel leaking and dripping water: sparse individual drips over a quiet room tone. Quiet (mean -45 dB), needs gain. The drip layer the other two lack; could sit under either of them.
